name: reactio-overleaf
description: Paste Reactio Draw figures into Overleaf with their files.

scripts.e2e: esbuild test/e2e/harness.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=test/e2e/harness.js && node test/e2e/run.mjs test/e2e/screenshot.png && node test/e2e/run-edit.mjs && node test/e2e/run-compounds.mjs test/e2e/compounds.png && node test/e2e/run-visual.mjs test/e2e/scheme.pdf test/e2e/visual.png
scripts.host: cd host && GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -ldflags=-s -o ../dist/host/mac-arm64 . && GOOS=darwin GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags=-s -o ../dist/host/mac-amd64 . && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags=-s -o ../dist/host/reactio-overleaf-host.exe . && GOOS=windows GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -ldflags=-s -o ../dist/host/reactio-overleaf-host-arm64.exe . && go build -o ../dist/host/linux .
scripts.package: npm run check && npm run build && zip -r reactio-overleaf.zip manifest.json dist images LICENSE NOTICE README.md
